name: policy-hound-reactive
description: Closed-loop rebuild of hound-jump.json, which needed two fixed-timestamp taps (880ms for the column-39 step, 1330ms to dodge the hound's tell before it commits) — a pairing the adversarial report (H3) found breaks the moment CP1's pace tuning changes when the player actually arrives, because the low route's window is one-to-two frames wide RELATIVE TO A MOVING ARRIVAL TIME. This script schedules zero timed jumps: 'pinned' clears whatever terrain is actually in the way whenever it actually jams, and 'houndTell' dodges the charge whenever the hound actually plants, regardless of build-specific timing. Same URL/enemies/window as hound-jump.json so the two are otherwise comparable.
